notes: schedule.json is authoritative for visible daily tasks.
Diya uses full 59-question timed section blocks as the backbone on normal days, plus one supplemental targeted/mixed block.
Diya normal-day question targets ramp approximately 70 -> 90 -> 105 -> 115 -> 125, then taper to about 60 before the exam.
Diya section emphasis rotates B/B, C/P, P/S, B/B, C/P, Mixed; CARS is separate.
Deep review appears once per normal day.
Hamzah's existing working schedule is preserved, including completion-based chapter progression.
Full-length and next-day review dates override normal Diya workload.
